features: One finite native charge envelope; amplitude 26..184 with 20 ms samples
On/off fallback increases duty cycle instead of requesting unsupported amplitudes
Charge cancellation on release, pause, overcharge, restart and disposal
notes: The existing Android VIBRATE manifest processor is retained.
Gameplay feedback is separate from audio volume and audio-library assignment.
UI, shaders and character material files were not edited for this task. Concurrent user edits to Menu.unity and SettingsPopup.prefab were preserved.
The continuous charge envelope is implemented for Android; iOS retains discrete landing feedback through the existing native bridge.
